paper.title: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline
paper.source_type: arXiv v2 (2020-10-22, main paper and appendices)

extraction: Complete systematic read of all 24 pages of user-supplied arXiv:2004.07211v2 (22 Oct 2020), including references and appendices A–G. PyMuPDF raw per-page text plus PDF-verified transcription of core equations and algorithms; 17 original page captures at 1.6x for all 4 figures, 10 tables, and 3 algorithms (multipart locations recorded). PDF pp. 3, 4, 6, 7, 15 inspected individually and all source-asset pages inspected in a contact sheet. Page images retain context and are internal originals, not web-ready assets or reuse-rights approval.
